title: Polymorph
blurb: This thing will keep haunting you, even when you're at death's door.
synopsis: An old man on his deathbed reflects on three encounters he had with a mysterious shape-shifting entity throughout his lifetime.

title: Ode to the Void
blurb: A cosmic journey within the boundary of life and death.
synopsis: In the distant future, a military astronaut awakens from a coma and finds himself incomprehensibly linked to an ancient alien megastructure that could hold the key to immortality and to the mystery of his own existence.

title: A Princess in Paris
blurb: A love story amidst cruelty and despair.
synopsis: In Nazi-occupied Paris, a teenager falls for a peculiar girl hailing from a mysterious kingdom threatened by the Germans.

title: The Reflection
blurb: Inside The Reach, reality is immaterial.
synopsis: A detective investigates disappearances inside an old power station which serves as a gateway to an oneiric world existing beyond our plane of reality.

title: Ice Rainbow
blurb: In times of fear and paranoia, everything's allowed.
synopsis: As the Cold War reaches its zenith, the stories of a Soviet defector, a CIA agent and US Navy pilots unfold as they attempt to uncover a deeply buried secret out within the expanse of the Bering Sea.

title: The Call From Beyond
blurb: The city bears everything they've ever wanted.
synopsis: Three tales evolve across different centuries where three explorers attempt to find a mystical city they’ve only ever encountered in their dreams.

title: Time Empire
blurb: What if we could reshape reality?
synopsis: Amidst a strange pandemic, an ailing detective investigates the mysterious disappearance of a woman and her daughter.

title: The Picnic
blurb: What happened to Anna?
synopsis: After his girlfriend’s disappearance in a forest where dream, memory and reality are intertwined, a man tries to reconnect with her by returning to the area and hopefully vanquishing his demons.

title: Wicked Crossings
status: In Development - Story Fully Planned Out
blurb: You wouldn't wish this on your worst enemy.
synopsis: Within an inescapable labyrinthine ghost town, a man assumes multiple identities whilst being chased by unknown assailants.

title: Assimilation
blurb: The truth lies on the surface.
synopsis: Within a post-apocalyptic Earth, a man embarks on a quest to unravel the mysteries behind the world's downfall through visions of someone who lived before the apocalypse.

title: The Palace of Dr. Remarde
status: In Development - Story Fully Planned Out
blurb: Who's Seud?
synopsis: Several eccentric characters (and a sheep) find themselves at a party in a palace governed by strange rules of reality and overseen by a God-like presence who seems to be tied to the characters’ misfortune.

title: Midnight Veil
status: In Development - Story Fully Planned Out
blurb: It all leads back to her.
synopsis: Ten years after a man spends a fateful night with an enigmatic woman, her reappearance draws him into a complex web involving aliens, a Russian agent, a Polish gangster and a Japanese scientist all somehow connected to her.

title: Nephilims

title: Lost Harmony
blurb: Her music could reshape everything.
synopsis: After the mysterious death of an online friend, an aspiring singer is pulled into a dark web community that claims her music holds unearthly powers and warns that the forces behind her friend’s death are now closing in on her.

title: Paradise Whirl
blurb: Paradise isn't always what it looks like.
synopsis: On a seemingly idyllic island, several lives weave together in a ballet of violence, addiction, corruption and the many woes that besmirch the country.

title: A Strange Fascination for Poetry
blurb: Why is he truly back?
synopsis: During a devastating war, a soldier unexpectedly returns home to reunite with the love of his life but suspicions on why he’s truly back threaten to jeopardize everything he holds dear.

title: Asymmetry
blurb: A ghost from the past.
synopsis: In the wake of a past lover’s suicide, a woman begins to experience ghostly apparitions while trying to make sense of his passing.

title: Symmetry
blurb: Is she just a dream?
synopsis: Plagued by strange dreams and an unexplainable connection to an unknown woman, a man's world is thrown into disarray when he starts receiving warnings of an imminent existential threat linked to his experiences.

title: Starless
blurb: The pillar of light shall bear the truth about their origin.
synopsis: Millions of years into the future, a group of astronauts on a pilgrimage journey in search of eternal life are contacted by the dying civilization of a rogue planet.

title: Fractal
blurb: A house unbounded by the arrow of time.
synopsis: A woman inherits a mansion that encloses ten versions of itself from different time periods, each with its own story that eventually merges with each other.
